# S3 bucket showing error access denied

1. Check what is the status of other S3 buckets, whether all buckets are showing error or not
2. Check IAM user/role has the following permissions\
   ![](data:image/png;base64,)
3. Possible login from the root user and check what is the status of the error bucket
   1. &#x20;by checking the correct access permission for that IAM user.
   2. by checking the bucket level permission by looking into the S3 bucket list.
4. Check the bucket has any custom policy
